context: A small café in Shibuya. Hiroshi (the boss) and Asuka (the teacher) were classmates in university. They run into each other for the first time in fifteen years.
purpose: old-friends reunion — accidental, slightly awkward, then real

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.style: Soft double-take on the opening. Voice lifts with genuine surprise, searching for confirmation. Mid-register, warm underneath the shock.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: …あすか？うわ、本当に久しぶり。
lines.en: …Asuka? Wow — it's really been a while.
lines.style: Low, almost breathy opening. Then the smile breaks through on 「本当に」. Composed exterior cracks. Quiet warmth—not performed, remembered.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.en: How many years has it been? Fifteen?
lines.style: Quick, brisk rhythm. Already leaning in before the question lands. Eager to place the time. No hesitation—just direct, engaged energy.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: そのくらい…本当に、時間ってあっという間。
lines.en: Around that… really—time passes so fast.
lines.style: A man suddenly aware of his own age. Slower tempo. Thoughtful landing on 「時間」. The words carry a small weight—not heavy, just present.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.en: You look well. Where are you working now?
lines.style: Genuinely interested rhythm. Sits forward in the voice on the second question. Warm curiosity, no formality—just old classmate to old classmate.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 同じ会社で、ずっと。…部長になったよ。
lines.en: Same company the whole time. …Made department head.
lines.style: Steady until the admission. Slight hesitation before 「部長」. Pride and self-consciousness balanced—a man unused to taking credit, now offering it quietly.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: おお、すごい。一緒に勉強した子が…
lines.en: Wow—that's impressive. And here I studied beside you back then…
lines.style: A real laugh breaks through. Affectionate, genuinely delighted. The 「一緒に勉強した」 lands with fond exasperation—warmth that needs no apology.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Laughter that's rare from a composed boss. Genuine and brief. Recovers into the question with easy, real curiosity. No performance.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 日本語教えてる。本当に楽しいよ。
lines.en: I teach Japanese. It's truly rewarding.
lines.style: Direct, unadorned confidence. The 「本当に楽しい」 lands unguarded—genuine satisfaction without embellishment. Clear, settled in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: …合ってるね、あすかに。本当に。
lines.style: A small thoughtful pause before speaking. The words land like an observation held a long time. Not flattery—recognition. Tender without softness.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ね、また飲みに行こ。時間、作って？
lines.en: Come on—let's grab drinks again. You'll make the time?
lines.style: Half command, half genuine invitation. Old-friend confidence fully on. A lift at the end—not quite a question, not quite a statement. Expecting yes.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 本当に、作る。連絡先、交換しよう。
lines.en: I really will. Let's exchange numbers.
lines.style: Decision made, no hesitation. Small but firm. The phone's already coming out in the voice. Action follows the words—no backtracking.
